Download package files and install depen.en: Download package files and install dependencies.
Download package files and install depen.zh: 下载包文件并安装依赖。

Read project API data for automation..en: Read project API data for automation.
Read project API data for automation..zh: 读取项目 API 数据用于自动化。

Write project API data for automation..en: Write project API data for automation.
Write project API data for automation..zh: 写入项目 API 数据用于自动化。

Project access tokens can also use read_.en: Project access tokens can also use read_api/write_api for issue, merge request, wiki, job and runner automation.
Project access tokens can also use read_.zh: 项目访问令牌还可使用 read_api/write_api 自动化议题、合并请求、Wiki、任务和 Runner。

Deploy tokens are best for CI/CD and pro.en: Deploy tokens are best for CI/CD and production deploys that only need repository or package access.
Deploy tokens are best for CI/CD and pro.zh: 部署令牌适合只需要仓库或包访问权限的 CI/CD 与生产部署流程。

Use read_repository for clone/fetch; add.en: Use read_repository for clone/fetch; add write_repository for push.
Use read_repository for clone/fetch; add.zh: 克隆/拉取使用 read_repository；需要推送时增加 write_repository。

Use read_package/write_package for packa.en: Use read_package/write_package for package pull/publish automation.
Use read_package/write_package for packa.zh: 包拉取/发布自动化使用 read_package/write_package。

Deploy keys can be stored and marked rea.en: Deploy keys can be stored and marked read-only or can-push. HTTP clone uses tokens today; SSH clone transport is not enabled yet.
Deploy keys can be stored and marked rea.zh: 部署密钥当前可以保存并标记为只读或可推送。HTTP 克隆目前使用令牌；SSH 克隆传输尚未启用。

When Git asks for credentials, enter the.en: When Git asks for credentials, enter the token username as the username and the token as the password.
When Git asks for credentials, enter the.zh: Git 询问凭据时，用户名填写令牌用户名，密码填写令牌值。

Token created. Copy it now because it wi.en: Token created. Copy it now because it will not be shown again.
Token created. Copy it now because it wi.zh: 令牌已创建。请立即复制，它之后不会再次显示。

Git clone with token.zh: 带令牌的 Git 克隆

Copy authenticated remote command.zh: 复制认证 remote 命令

Store tokens in CI secrets or local cred.en: Store tokens in CI secrets or local credential helpers instead of committing them to repository files.
Store tokens in CI secrets or local cred.zh: 请将令牌存入 CI Secret 或本地凭据助手，不要提交到仓库文件中。

Copy publish and install commands for th.en: Copy publish and install commands for the selected package protocol. Use a project access token or deploy token with package scopes.
Copy publish and install commands for th.zh: 复制当前包协议的发布和安装命令。请使用带包权限的项目访问令牌或部署令牌。

Upload arbitrary build artifacts through.en: Upload arbitrary build artifacts through the generic registry endpoint.
Upload arbitrary build artifacts through.zh: 通过 generic registry 端点上传任意构建产物。

Use the npm endpoint for package metadat.en: Use the npm endpoint for package metadata and publish payloads.
Use the npm endpoint for package metadat.zh: 使用 npm 端点读取包元数据并发布 payload。

Upload Maven artifacts by repository-rel.en: Upload Maven artifacts by repository-relative artifact path.
Upload Maven artifacts by repository-rel.zh: 按仓库相对 artifact 路径上传 Maven 产物。

Expose a simple Python package index and.en: Expose a simple Python package index and upload distribution files.
Expose a simple Python package index and.zh: 暴露 Python simple index，并上传发行文件。

Use the NuGet v3 service index and raw p.en: Use the NuGet v3 service index and raw package upload endpoint.
Use the NuGet v3 service index and raw p.zh: 使用 NuGet v3 service index 和原始包上传端点。

Use this checklist to connect Git tags,.en: Use this checklist to connect Git tags, package artifacts, and release links into one consumable delivery flow.
Use this checklist to connect Git tags,.zh: 使用该清单把 Git tag、包产物和 release 链接串成一个可消费的交付流程。

At least one asset link is attached.en: At least one asset link is attached
At least one asset link is attached.zh: 至少已关联一个资产链接

Publish the build output to the package.en: Publish the build output to the package registry first, then add the package download URL or external artifact URL as a release asset link.
Publish the build output to the package.zh: 先把构建产物发布到 package registry，再把包下载地址或外部产物地址作为 release asset link 添加。
